svg.text: ▐ Picking up the maintainability job from last night.

text.font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▐ I split the router into three files and opened #313.

svg.text: > why did you leave the auth routes in one file?

text.font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▐ Open PR #298 touches src/auth.ts, so it was off limits

text.font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: ▐ tonight. The guard would have blocked the push.

svg.text: ▐ Want me to do that half once #298 merges?
